text:
Devon Chen: Kicking off aurora2 cluster bring-up validation. Core checks: GPU driver/firmware, NVLink topology, kernel params, inter-pod networking, egress NAT, SLO smoke, cost-tagging. Ping @Maria Alvarez @Alex P. We'll do a 30m smoke window then handoff.

Maria Alvarez: On it. I'll run the smoke suite and baseline perf. Add a cost tag: billing:aurora2. Also need KMS access verified for private nodes.

Alex P.: Reminder: last time we saw a driver mismatch on nova group — run `nvidia-smi -q | grep Driver` across nodes. Also check CUDA compat: `dpkg -l | grep cuda`.

Devon Chen: Good call. Proposed minimal smoke steps: 1) healthchecks: kube-system pods, node Ready 2) nvidia-smi + driver validation 3) NVLink probe 4) iperf between two worker pods 5) sample inference load (p50 < 80ms) 6) egress NAT / cost tagging 7) alerting webhook test.

Maria Alvarez: Running step 1-3 now. Commands: ```kubectl get pods -n kube-system && kubectl get nodes -o wide``` ```for n in $(kubectl get nodes -o name); do kubectl describe $n | egrep 'Kernel|OS Image|Kubelet'; done```

DeployBot: Deployment aurora2-bootstrap finished: 72 nodes provisioned, 6 failed init (retrying). Link: https://internal.deploy/aurora2/2051

Alex P.: Hit two nodes with driver 525.85 vs expected 530.41. I'll roll driver update playbook `ansible-playbook playbooks/gpu-driver-update.yml -e region=aurora2 --limit=bad_nodes`.

Maria Alvarez: NVLink check shows inconsistent topology on node-17 (missing link b -> c). Suggest we cordon node-17 and reimage. `kubectl cordon node-17`.

Ops Lead: Hold on reimage until we confirm storage paths. Node-17 has local NVMe with important logs. Ops will snapshot. :police_officer:

Devon Chen: Agreed. Snapshot in progress. While that's happening, can we run iperf test across two healthy nodes? Alex, Maria, coordinate.

Alex P.: iperf run (server): `kubectl run -i --tty iperf-server --image=networkstatic/iperf3 -- /bin/sh -c 'iperf3 -s'` then client: `iperf3 -c <server-ip> -t 10 -P 4`. Expect >10 Gbps in-rack.

Maria Alvarez: iperf results: 9.6 Gbps between workers in same rack, 4.2 Gbps cross-rack — within expected for non-jumbo. Documenting in checklist.

DeployBot: Smoke test suite (basic) completed: 1 fail (node-17 NVLink), 1 warn (cross-rack perf). Logs: https://internal.logs/aurora2/2051/smoke

Devon Chen: Updated checklist: mark node-17 for reimage + SLA gating: if >1 node NVLink fail or p50 > 120ms we don't handoff. Current p50 inference on sample model running 72ms. Ops Lead, can you confirm KMS/access checks?

Ops Lead: KMS policies OK, private nodes have access. Billing tag applied to resource groups.

Maria Alvarez: I'm comfortable signing off on base smoke. I'll add items to runbook and handoff doc. :thumbsup:

Alex P.: I'll run driver fix and follow up in the thread when done.
